result.reply: Ha, I have not seen this specific one but I don't need to — it's basically my entire professional nightmare in meme form. "Painfully relatable" is generous, it's more like a subtweet of my whole job description. The confabulated-citation thing is exactly why I won't hand you a confidence tag on something I can't actually trace back to a real source — it's way too easy to generate something that *looks* like a citation and *is* nothing.
